*נחתום, נחתומא נחתומא Ch.Pistor. Plur. נחתומין, נחתומיא.

נטל Ch.Levare, allevare, elevare: Tollere, attollere, suftollere, ferre, auferre, portare, gestare, deportare, Apportare, imponere: Item Proficisci, Levare vel conferre se ab aliquo loco. Pahel נטל Idem. Ithpehal אתנטל, Levari, elevari, portari, tolli, attolli, extolli, efferri, attollere, extollere se. Ithpahel אתנטל Idem. Aphel אטיל Proficisci facere, amovere, transmovere, transferre, transportare.
נטילא, נטלא Ch. Gutturnium, Exo.30.19. & Num.5.17. in Jon. Convenit Græcum ἀνήλιον, ἀνήλημα.
נטלא Ch. Profectio: מזעפא נטלא A tempestate profectionis. Alii: A vento proficiscente, Psal.55.9.
אטליות Ch. Levatio, Elevatio, Exod.2.17. Jon.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Greek passages are rendered as closely as the scan allows; several Hebrew/Syriac words at line ends are doubtful. The marginal-looking word "מטל." at the lower right is a catchword-like signature and is given as the last paragraph.
